owner_evidence_needed: Channel, date/time, matter type, jurisdiction/location note, responsible intake owner
common_blocker: Enquiries split across phone, web form, email and WhatsApp with no single owner
review_gate: Confirm minimum fields before any conflict search
unsafe_claim_to_avoid: guaranteed lead capture or client growth

owner_evidence_needed: Names needed for firm-approved conflict process, relationship role, opposing/related party fields, matter category
common_blocker: Missing related-party names or matter context delays attorney review
review_gate: Route incomplete conflict packets to a human before consultation confirmation

owner_evidence_needed: Which facts should not be collected in public forms or unmanaged chat
common_blocker: Prospects over-share facts before scope, conflict or confidentiality boundaries are clear
review_gate: Use approved wording and stop-rules before automation asks follow-up questions

owner_evidence_needed: Conflict status, attorney availability, consultation type, confirmation status, reminder owner
common_blocker: Appointments are booked before conflict status or consultation scope is ready
review_gate: Only schedule under the firm-approved rule

owner_evidence_needed: Proposal/engagement status, last touch, pending document, payment/admin next step, follow-up date
common_blocker: Warm prospects stall after consult because follow-up ownership is unclear
review_gate: Separate admin follow-up from legal advice and payment decisions

owner_evidence_needed: Decline reason category, approved wording, referral/non-engagement handoff note, record-retention owner
common_blocker: No-fit enquiries remain open and create response risk
review_gate: Use firm-approved non-engagement or referral language only
unsafe_claim_to_avoid: legal outcome or referral quality guaranteed

owner_evidence_needed: Open enquiries, incomplete conflict packets, awaiting attorney review, scheduled consultations, stale follow-ups
common_blocker: Owner cannot see which intake queue is leaking
review_gate: Review daily before expanding automation or AI receptionist coverage
unsafe_claim_to_avoid: automation performance, SLA, savings or ROI achieved

owner_evidence_needed: Which claims can be made publicly and which require real evidence or professional review
common_blocker: Marketing copy overstates legal tech impact or firm results
review_gate: Block claims that imply client results, rankings, ethics clearance or guaranteed growth
unsafe_claim_to_avoid: ranking, demand, client, revenue or case outcome claim
